literal_meaning: to make a sound or call out
figurative_meaning_en: to make a mocking or jeering sound from behind
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় সে পিছন থেকে আওয়াজ দিয়ে বিদ্রুপ করল।
রাস্তায় মেয়েরা যাচ্ছে, কয়েকজন ছেলে আওয়াজ দিচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He jeered from the back during the meeting.
Some boys are catcalling the girls passing on the street.
note: Often used in contexts of public teasing or harassment, comparable to catcalling in English.
